races.paceDynamic: Quay Item is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady, sustainable gallop over this 2m3½f trip on soft ground. With Piping Rock, Beau Quali and Treasure Planet sitting prominently behind the leader, there's enough pace interest to ensure honest fractions without destructive pressure early. The lack of multiple pace-pressers means Quay Item can control the tempo, creating conditions where horses positioned close to the pace can travel smoothly into contention. This tactical setup clearly favors prominent racers and front-runners who can stay in touch without expending excessive energy, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground in testing conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Quay Item Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Quay Item is allowed to dictate a comfortable early pace without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The Henderson-trained leader can use his proven stamina to kick clear approaching the final flight, with the soft ground suiting his style perfectly. Prominent racers who travel easily behind him will benefit from the honest gallop but may struggle to reel him in up the testing Chepstow hill.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Piping Rock or Beau Quali apply sustained pressure to Quay Item from the fourth last hurdle
scenarios.body: The increased tempo exposes any stamina doubts in the leader while setting up the race for horses with tactical speed who can stay close to the pace. Piping Rock's consistent form figures and Gavin Sheehan's tactical awareness become decisive factors in a battle between the front division.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and allows a strong finisher to close from off the tempo
scenarios.body: Vanderflier or one of the other hold-up horses finds significant improvement from their recent wind surgery or stable switch to mount a late challenge. The soft ground aids their stamina but the sustained nature of Chepstow's finish makes this a difficult task against horses who've traveled smoothly throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Quay Item fails to handle the soft conditions or makes jumping errors under the 7lb claimer
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with no clear pace-setter, potentially suiting an improver like Treasure Planet who can adapt tactically. Paul Nicholls' juvenile has shown progressive tendencies and Harry Cobden can position him to take advantage of any pace disruption.

watchPoints.text: Quay Item under the 7lb claimer - any jumping errors or pace misjudgment from the inexperienced rider could collapse the front-running plan entirely
Vanderflier's quick return after disappointing efforts - if the wind surgery has worked he could outrun odds from his hold-up position
Treasure Planet's jumping - Paul Nicholls juveniles can find significant improvement but hurdles technique will determine if he can capitalize on any pace scenario
Early pace development - watch if any of the prominent horses challenge Quay Item early which could set up the race for closers
Beau Quali's hurdles record - despite recent seconds his 0-13 stat over obstacles suggests he may find winning difficult even in this moderate contest

races.name: Sun Trade Windows Final Pride Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Broomfields Cave

runners_data.spotlight: Right back to form on last month's second start after 16 months out, just holding on in a Uttoxeter Class 4 (3m, good to soft); form of that win remains untested, but 4lb rise probably fair; effective on good also.

runners_data.name: Charles Ritz

runners_data.name: Amateur
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner whose best form comes over longer trips and specifically at Ffos Las rather than here.
runners_data.comment: This is his time of year, but was an early casualty on recent first outing since May 2025.
runners_data.spotlight: Last four victories all gained over Ffos Las's 3m4f trip in April or May (good, good to soft); present attainment level is conjectural, having survived just two fences on his recent first outing since last May.

races.paceDynamic: Manothepeople is the sole confirmed front runner in this small field and will dictate proceedings from the outset over this stamina-sapping 3m2f trip. Behind him, Inflexible, Loup De Maulde, Charles Ritz and Amateur all show prominent tendencies, creating a bunched group in behind the leader through the early stages. The pace will be measured rather than frantic given Manothepeople's uncontested lead, with the real action delayed until the closing stages as the prominent runners fan out to challenge. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the steady gallop and finish with one sustained run, making Broomfields Cave's patient style perfectly suited to exploit this race shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Manothepeople gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The measured pace plays into his stamina strengths and he proves hard to peg back in the closing stages. His course and distance success gives him a significant edge when allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows Broomfields Cave to deliver his trademark late run
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as he storms past tiring leaders in the final furlong. His excellent recent form and proven ability at this level make him the primary beneficiary of a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can stay close enough to Manothepeople and outkick him
scenarios.body: Inflexible or Charles Ritz use their forward positions to stay in touch before finding extra in the final half-mile. Their proximity to the pace gives them the tactical edge over the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Favours Veteran
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and extended trip becomes a true test of stamina
scenarios.body: Amateur's proven ability over longer trips at this course comes to the fore in the closing stages. His multiple Ffos Las victories show he can find extra when the pace becomes searching.

watchPoints.text: Manothepeople could get too easy a lead in front with no other natural pace angles in this small field
Inflexible's fitness after 16 months off - his Uttoxeter win may not reflect true ability level yet
Broomfields Cave's jumping at the last two fences where he can get low when in contention
Charles Ritz handling the step up in trip to 3m2f for the first time in his career
Amateur's advancing years at 13 making him vulnerable if the pace quickens significantly

races.paceDynamic: Grand Harbour is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner maiden hurdle field, with Good Girl Rachel and Mariole likely to race prominently but neither aggressive pace-setters. This sets up a moderate gallop with Grand Harbour able to dictate terms without pressure, allowing the large pack of hold-up horses including My Boy Aaron, Both Of Us, Polemon and Trapper John to track behind in a bunched field. The lack of early pace will create a tactical affair that builds steadily, likely producing a sprint finish from the final hurdle. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Harbour sets steady fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the last hurdle where horses with tactical pace can quicken best. Those positioned prominently or just behind the leaders can strike decisively while pure hold-up horses get caught too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Stayers
scenarios.trigger: If Good Girl Rachel or Mariole press Grand Harbour early creating honest pace throughout
scenarios.body: The stronger gallop stretches the field and favours those with stamina and finishing kick from off the pace. Hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with more time to wind up their challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Harbour gets completely uncontested lead and finds improvement on hurdle debut
scenarios.body: The modest pace allows the leader to save energy early then pull clear when the pressure comes, with soft ground aiding stamina. Prominent runners and those who can track the leader closest have best chance of chasing home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Inexperienced Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If several of the hurdle debutants and lightly-raced horses make jumping errors or fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with fallers and mistakes creating gaps, allowing any horse who jumps fluently and stays on their feet to pick up the pieces. Experience over hurdles becomes the key factor.

watchPoints.text: Grand Harbour could get uncontested lead if no other horse goes forward early, making him very dangerous despite poor hurdle debut
My Boy Aaron has been placed three times recently over hurdles and looks the most consistent performer in weak maiden company
Both Of Us carries just 150lbs as a four-year-old and represents strong connections despite modest rating
Jubertlee makes hurdle debut at age nine from point-to-point racing where recent form suggests ability
Several horses including Queens Up and Angel Wave return quickly from poor efforts, suggesting connections expect improvement

races.paceDynamic: Five Valleys will look to make the running from the front with One Island and Cheap Sandwiches likely to track closely in prominent positions. The pace should be genuine but not frantic given Five Valleys' tendency to fade suggests he won't go too fast early. With most runners preferring to be held up including Aimeric, Miss Kingston and Just Call Me Buzz, this creates a patient tactical affair where the pace will build gradually. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick when the tempo lifts, rather than hold-up horses who may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Five Valleys sets a steady pace without burning out the field early
scenarios.body: The patient tempo allows prominent runners to travel strongly and strike first when the pace quickens approaching the final flight. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground as the leaders have saved enough for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where horses with the best turn of foot can overcome positioning disadvantages. The patient early fractions allow hold-up horses to get into contention and unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Five Valleys Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Five Valleys finds more stamina than his previous fade suggests and gets loose
scenarios.body: His front-running style pays dividends when he can dictate throughout and the field fails to organize an effective pursuit. The honest pace he sets proves just sustainable enough to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Market Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lesser-fancied runners finds significant improvement from their debut efforts
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows an improving horse to travel within themselves before producing an unexpected late rattle. Previous form proves misleading as jumps racing often reveals hidden ability.

watchPoints.text: Five Valleys must be monitored early - if he gets an easy lead and doesn't face pressure, he could steal a march despite his fading tendency
Louis Des Landes in the betting ring - any market support suggests connections confident after his early unseating last time
Miss Kingston's headgear - any equipment changes could signal trainer's attempt to harness her inconsistent but proven ability
One Island's jumping - his hurdles debut saw him drop out tamely so early fluency will be crucial for Nicholls runner
Aimeric's positioning - smart Flat horse needs to be handy enough to use his class when the tempo lifts in the straight

runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid course form but tendency to jump right, off a T14 record of 0/12 for Jeremy Scott
runners_data.comment: Exeter and Chepstow winner with cut; plenty of chances off tonight's sort of mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Sometime tendency to jump right hasn't been sufficient to deny him victory around here in the past, and he's never hit the deck in 22 career starts; issue is more that he's now 0-10 racing from official marks above the 104 he denied at Exeter in January (2m1f, good to soft).

runners_data.name: Torneo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse disadvantaged by likely slow pace, jumping errors cost him last time in stronger company at this venue
runners_data.comment: Consistent before finding a Class 2 over further too big an ask here latest; player.
runners_data.spotlight: Jumping let him down in what was effectively a 0-150 handicap here latest (2m3f, good to soft); his string of low-130s RPRs before that read well in tonight's company, however, and although still 9lb above any mark defied he did land a C&D novice handicap last year on one other visit.

runners_data.name: Parramount
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but unexposed over fences with just one chase start, 28 days since last run freshens him up
runners_data.comment: Struggling for form since November's hurdles second; unconvincing chase debut latest.
runners_data.spotlight: Chance on November's Doncaster hurdles second, less so on all which has followed; unexposed in this sphere, with one start over fences compared to the other trio's 41 combined, but none too convincing on that belated chase debut at Wetherby latest (1m7f, good), jumping left and weakening.

runners_data.name: Hypotenus
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner gets tactical advantage in small field, 64 days off but proven fresh and won when controlling pace at Taunton
runners_data.comment: Back to within 2lb of the mark he lowered at Taunton in January (2m, good); stable debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Able to dominate when cashing in a career-low mark at Taunton in January (2m, good), his sole win in 14 chasing starts; hasn't gone on since, but back to within 2lb of that figure now and one previous wind operation provoked a small spike in form; chance on first start for new yard.

races.paceDynamic: Hypotenus will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field of four. The sole front-runner can dictate terms and set a controlled gallop over two miles on testing ground, unlikely to face early pressure from prominent runners Bonza Boy and Parramount. Torneo as the only hold-up horse faces a tactical disadvantage if the pace becomes pedestrian and he's left with too much to do. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics, with Hypotenus able to dominate and the forward-going horses getting first run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hypotenus Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Hypotenus jumps cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent horses
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear approaching the last fence when the hold-up horse still has ground to make up. The uncontested lead on testing ground suits his front-running style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Bonza Boy and Parramount press Hypotenus earlier than usual to prevent him stealing the race
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates gaps for the experienced prominent runners to exploit down the stretch. Torneo's hold-up style becomes even more compromised in a truly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Torneo Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Torneo gets the slow-run race his style demands
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse can use his superior class rating to outfinish tired leaders in the final furlong. His recent jumping errors become less costly in a tactical finish where position matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Parramount Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran's chasing inexperience proves an advantage rather than hindrance in this small field
scenarios.body: His fresher legs over fences compared to these seasoned chasers help him find extra in the closing stages. The testing conditions suit his stamina reserves better than his more exposed rivals.

watchPoints.text: Watch Hypotenus at the first few fences after 64 days off - any early jumping error surrenders his crucial tactical advantage
Monitor if Bonza Boy's rightward jumping tendency worsens on the testing ground and disrupts his rhythm
Check if Torneo gets squeezed for room in the small field turning for home given his hold-up style needs a clear run
Observe whether Parramount's chasing inexperience shows when the pace quickens, having had just one fence start
Watch for early pressure on Hypotenus from the prominent horses - any sustained challenge changes the entire complexion

races.name: Sun Trade Windows Cherry Gold Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: The Kemble Brewery
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter with solid recent form, headgear retained, and only 13 days since bouncing back to form
runners_data.comment: Bumped into an even less exposed handicapper over C&D latest (pair 9l clear); player.
runners_data.spotlight: Endured a sobering chase debut here in November (sole start on good) but firmly back on track on sole start since when finding only an even less exposed handicapper too good over C&D a fortnight ago (good to soft; pair 9l clear); cheekpieces added; retains plenty of upside.

runners_data.name: Wreckless Eric
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist needing strong pace, second-time cheekpieces after Aintree disappointment, solid on similar going
runners_data.comment: Aintree flop latest isn't without precedent; easier task here and ought not mind a dryout.
runners_data.spotlight: For two years in a row now he's followed a second in the Imperial Cup with a disappointing effort at Aintree, second-time cheekpieces presumably not to blame latest as they're retained here; record of 1F12 in handicaps of Class 3 or below, and ought not mind any dryout (2-4 on good).

runners_data.name: Razzle Dazzle Boy
runners_data.note: Proven course performer but 62-day absence is a concern, effective on softer surfaces with prominent style
runners_data.comment: Leicester win and two C&D seconds since Christmas all gained with some give underfoot.
runners_data.spotlight: C&D seconds either side of January's Leicester win (1m7f, heavy) speak well of his effectiveness around galloping tracks with at least some give underfoot; drying forecast worries more than latest 1lb rise.

runners_data.name: American Land
runners_data.note: Prefers good ground so needs drying conditions, hat-trick winner but all on faster surfaces than current going
runners_data.comment: Pestered in lead and made errors on recent return; would certainly appreciate a dryout.
runners_data.spotlight: Taunton win this time last year was the first leg of an eventual hat-trick (2m1f-2m3f) all recorded on good or quicker surfaces, so drying forecast is all to the good; chance, assuming he's not goaded into making the same sorts of errors as on his recent return here.

runners_data.name: Inside Man
runners_data.note: Requires strong pace for hold-up style to be effective, disappointing return but previous handicap debut success notable
runners_data.comment: C&D novice winner this time last year; handicap win came off just 2lb lower; chance.
runners_data.spotlight: Never able to get competitive returning from five months out in a big-field Sussex Champion Hurdle recently, but September's handicap debut win came off only 2lb lower than today's mark and he landed a good-ground C&D novice event exactly a year ago; could well get back on track.

races.paceDynamic: The Kemble Brewery looks the most natural early leader with his prominent style, likely setting a steady tempo without pressure from the small field. Razzle Dazzle Boy and American Land may track closely in second and third, while the hold-up pair Wreckless Eric and Inside Man will settle towards the rear. With only five runners and no confirmed strong pace-pressers, this sets up as a moderate gallop that will quicken from the final flight. This tactical shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can position handy and have something left to kick, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Kemble Brewery sets reasonable fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The handy runners can conserve energy and outkick the field from ideal positions, with hold-up horses struggling to make up ground in the small field. This tactical setup perfectly suits prominent racers with the class to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners pushing forward
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for a closer to sweep past tired leaders, with Wreckless Eric's class telling late. Inside Man could also benefit if the pace collapse is severe enough for his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: American Land's Perfect Storm
scenarios.trigger: If the going continues to dry out and he gets an ideal stalking position
scenarios.body: His preference for good ground surfaces and his hat-trick winning form comes to the fore in a moderate pace scenario. The 8-year-old's experience could prove decisive in a tactical finish from his prominent position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Razzle Dazzle Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If his long absence proves no hindrance and he reproduces his C&D seconds form
scenarios.body: His proven effectiveness at the track and distance combined with less weight than the top-rated pair could see him capitalize on a moderate pace. The 62-day break might have him fresher than his more recently raced rivals.

watchPoints.text: Watch The Kemble Brewery's early positioning - if he gets an uncontested lead the small field may struggle to peg him back
Monitor American Land for signs of struggling on the current going compared to his good ground hat-trick sequence
Check if Wreckless Eric gets the strong pace he needs or if the small field creates a tactical disadvantage for hold-up horses
Observe Razzle Dazzle Boy for any signs of ring-rust after his 62-day layoff despite his course form
Watch for any market moves on Inside Man given his trainer's poor recent 14-day strike rate

races.name: Dunraven Bowl Pink Eyed Pedro "Grassroots' Open Hunters" Chase

runners_data.name: Poppa Poutine
runners_data.note: Long absence of 391 days and unseated last time makes him unreliable despite prominent running style.
runners_data.comment: Hampered when unseating latest; experienced chaser, with all wins on softer than good.
runners_data.spotlight: Hampered when unseating in an open point at neighbouring Howick last month, and generally a safe ride; both handicap chase wins (from 17 starts over fences) have come over Wincanton's 3m1f on ground softer than good, and the drying forecast isn't strictly ideal.

runners_data.name: Yippee Ki Yay
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with good recent form but may struggle to repel late challenges over this extended trip.
runners_data.comment: Appears to have something to find with Stumps Or Slips, but no track or going type issues.
runners_data.spotlight: Track and going types come alike to this former Kelso and Exeter hunter chase winner (soft and good to soft); 11l behind a rival later drubbed by Stumps Or Slips on his most recent hunter chase start, but confidence levels topped up with an easy point win at Eyton-on-Severn (good to firm) since.

runners_data.name: Important Notice
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who beat Barton Snow last time and suits the likely tactical scenario perfectly.
runners_data.comment: Late-2024 defeat of Barton Snow looks better form now; unseated at Stratford last Sunday.
runners_data.spotlight: Remains the last horse to beat hunter chase star Barton Snow, albeit back in late 2024 on desperate ground; twice a Trebudannon open point winner (good to soft) since January's Hereford hunter chase exit which was not of his own making, but an unseat at Stratford last Sunday is harder to forgive.

runners_data.name: Ideal Du Tabert
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid form but lacks a recent winning run and may get caught between early pace and late kick.

runners_data.name: Windance
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner who fell last time but has strong record on similar going when fully wound up.
runners_data.comment: Blameless exit behind Stumps Or Slips latest, but not in the form this year to figure.
runners_data.spotlight: Landed back-to-back Fontwell and Wincanton staying handicap chases three years ago (good to soft); blameless exit behind Stumps Or Slips latest (hampered) but capable of throwing in his own errors or jumping right; form of this year's completed efforts falls well short of the required.

runners_data.name: Pink Eyed Pedro
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse carrying a 4lb penalty but has won this exact race before on good ground.
runners_data.comment: Won this in 2025, six years after first taking the same prize; 2l second on recent return.
runners_data.spotlight: Splendid old-timer who has won both confined novice (2019) and grassroots (2025) incarnations of this race (each on good); always held by a match-fit and five-years younger rival on this month's seasonal return, albeit beaten just 2l; likely to be spot on for his title defence.

runners_data.name: Stumps Or Slips
runners_data.note: Classic closer with the highest rating who demolished these rivals' conquerors last summer.
runners_data.comment: Proved stamina for 3m with ease at Exeter latest (good) and still on the up; big player.
runners_data.spotlight: Rampant in sub-3m good-ground hurdle races and chases last summer, and has the beating of Yippee Ki Yay on a line through Macklin, whom he trounced at Exeter last time (3m, good); still fairly lightly raced over this sort of trip, and drying forecast rates a big plus.

races.paceDynamic: Yippee Ki Yay will dictate from the front with no genuine pace pressure in this small field. The confirmed leader has shown he can sustain his gallop at Chepstow without being harassed early. Important Notice, Stumps Or Slips and Pink Eyed Pedro will all need cover and a patient ride from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the sustainable early gallop will set up perfectly for closers to strike in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late kick prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Yippee Ki Yay sets uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses time their moves perfectly
scenarios.body: The leader will weaken approaching the final fence as fresher finishers surge past with superior stamina reserves. Stumps Or Slips and Important Notice benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner stays
scenarios.trigger: If Yippee Ki Yay maintains his rhythm and the closers leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The leader's recent form suggests he can sustain his effort over this trip on favorable going. The prominent racers Ideal Du Tabert and Poppa Poutine lack the tactical speed to reel him in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race pressure builds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses Ideal Du Tabert or Poppa Poutine press Yippee Ki Yay earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This creates a stop-start gallop that fragments the field and makes timing crucial. The experienced campaigners with tactical nous gain the advantage in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Yippee Ki Yay goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously turning in
scenarios.body: A sprint finish ensues where class and recent form become decisive factors. The highest-rated horses with sharpest preparation hold sway in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Yippee Ki Yay if he goes too fast early - could capitulate quickly approaching the final fence
Important Notice for jumping errors - only 5 days since last run and has been sketchy over fences recently
Stumps Or Slips positioning turning in - needs to be within striking distance to unleash his superior finishing kick
Poppa Poutine for ring rustiness - 391 days off and unseated last time makes him unpredictable
Pink Eyed Pedro's jumping rhythm - the 15-year-old needs to be fluent to compensate for his advancing years

races.name: Braceys Master Charm Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: I Spy A Diva
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 113 days off with mixed signals about optimum trip this season
runners_data.comment: Mixed signals this term as to her present optimum trip, but weighted to strike again.
runners_data.spotlight: Sole 3m success was gained off tonight's mark in autumn 2022 (good); just one further win since (2m5f) and mixed signals this term as to her present optimum trip, but unarguably weighted to strike again.

runners_data.name: Hard Dealt
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but has failed in six handicaps off lower marks despite multiple placed efforts
runners_data.comment: Has only won a Worcester novice and failed in six handicaps off lower marks
runners_data.spotlight: Has only won a Worcester novice and failed in six handicaps off lower marks, though was runner-up in four of those; clearly has nothing up her sleeve mark-wise but should still run well.

runners_data.name: Love Me
runners_data.note: Prominent racer wearing tongue tie with recent Navan win suggesting return to form on testing ground
runners_data.comment: Seemed to pass stamina test over this C&D latest; up from 0-115 company but respected.
runners_data.spotlight: Big-field Navan winner in autumn 2024 and best British efforts have similarly been recorded in handicap hurdles around galloping tracks; trip didn't beat her when upped to this C&D latest (good to soft), failing by just over 2l, and she's not wholly dismissed despite the hotter company.

runners_data.name: Roaring Home
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been below par on two of last three starts including on sound surface
runners_data.comment: Below par on two of her last three outings, including latest; trip is not an obvious plus.
runners_data.spotlight: Below par on two of her last three outings, including latest when returned to the sound surface of her one career success; hasn't shaped as if in need of this second crack at a stayers' trip (pulled up in the first).

runners_data.name: Slim Marvel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with just one win in 24 attempts and limitations exposed in better company
runners_data.comment: Close second at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) was not built upon when back up to this class latest.
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win in 24, and Ffos Las near-miss on second outing for current handler likely owed something to the drop to 0-105 company (3m, heavy); limitations exposed again since and this is tougher still.

runners_data.name: Star Walking
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying top weight but capable of course record breaking performances in right conditions
runners_data.comment: Stopped early latest, but broke course record for Kempton's 3m over Christmas (good).
runners_data.spotlight: Effectively a 0-135 mares' handicap she took in course record time at Kempton over Christmas (good); can throw in the odd poor effort and there's something to take on trust after she stopped early on latest start (made a noise) but she's in the mix if all is well with her.

runners_data.name: Kilworth
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good record on soft ground despite February Plumpton failure on similar surface
runners_data.comment: Taunton and Ascot winner either side of a possibly forgivable Plumpton blip; up 7lb.
runners_data.spotlight: Her worst performance in Irish points had been recorded on soft, so perhaps February's Plumpton failure on similar ground ought not to have surprised; nicely progressive in staying handicaps otherwise with wins at Taunton and Ascot, though the 7lb rise since the latter asks a stiff question.

races.paceDynamic: I Spy A Diva will take them along at a steady gallop with Hard Dealt, Love Me, Slim Marvel and Kilworth all comfortable tracking in the prominent positions early. The lack of confirmed front runners means the pace will be manageable rather than searching, allowing the field to stay bunched through the middle stages. Star Walking and Roaring Home from the rear will need the pace to collapse or find gaps in the straight. This honest gallop over 2m7½f on testing ground favours the prominent racers who can position handily and kick when it matters rather than hold-up horses needing a strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the prominent runners control proceedings
scenarios.body: I Spy A Diva and Hard Dealt can dictate from the front while Love Me and Kilworth travel smoothly in behind to strike. The manageable gallop allows these handy runners to save energy for a sustained drive up the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace quickens unexpectedly or the prominent group go too hard
scenarios.body: Star Walking and Roaring Home benefit from a collapse as the front-runners tire on the testing ground. The class of Star Walking particularly shines when others have overdone it early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Staying Power Test
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and 2m7½f trip finds out the less genuine stayers
scenarios.body: Love Me's proven stamina and Kilworth's recent Plumpton success over similar conditions give them the edge. The combination of testing ground and extended distance sorts out the true stayers from the rest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the conditions or underperform
scenarios.body: Slim Marvel or Roaring Home capitalize on a weak renewal where the favorites disappoint. Either could benefit from a tactical race where positioning matters more than raw ability.

watchPoints.text: Star Walking carrying 170lbs at top of handicap could struggle to concede weight to in-form rivals
Love Me's tongue tie first-time application suggests breathing issues that need monitoring throughout
I Spy A Diva returning after 113-day break may need the run despite trainer's decent strike rate
Roaring Home's recent poor form on sound surfaces could reverse on preferred testing conditions
Hard Dealt running just one day after last outing could indicate trainer confidence or desperation
